class.name: SteamModerationReceiptResult
class.brief_description: A typed result from trusted Steam moderation.
class.description: Check [member SteamResult.ok] for success. The approved action's audit receipt remains available when its remote outcome is unresolved or the backend's terminal audit write fails. An audit write failure returns [constant ERR_DATABASE_CANT_WRITE]. The receipt's acknowledgment field retains the observed Steam outcome.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the approved action's audit receipt, including when its remote outcome is unresolved. Null when authorization was not granted.

members.member: The approved action's audit receipt, including when its remote outcome is unresolved. Null when authorization was not granted.
